macro_context.market_sentiment: Bullish rally on May 6 2026: Nasdaq +1.36% (25,670), Dow +1.14% (49,854), S&P 500 +1.10% (7,338.89). Markets recovering from Iran-war lows driven by hopes of a U.S.-Iran nuclear framework deal; oil prices falling as peace prospects improve. Small-caps and tech have led the rebound with Russell 2000 and Nasdaq setting new intraday records on May 5.
macro_context.fed_outlook: FOMC held benchmark fed funds rate at 3.50%-3.75% on April 29 2026 with an unusual 8-4 split, the most dissents since October 1992. Inflation remains elevated partly due to Middle East energy price spike. Markets price zero cuts in 2026 and well into 2027; Powell announced he will stay on the Fed Board indefinitely after Trump legal challenges. (Source: CNBC, Federal Reserve)
macro_context.geopolitical: U.S.-Iran conflict is the dominant risk: missile exchanges, UAE intercepts, and ongoing nuclear negotiations. White House reportedly close to a one-page MOU with Iran. Secondary risks include U.S. tariff/trade tensions, NATO posture in Greenland, and U.S. intervention in Venezuela. IMF downgraded global growth outlook in April 2026 citing these conflicts. (Source: TheStreet, IMF WEO Apr 2026)

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Wolfe Research downgraded JPM from Outperform to Peerperform on Jan 7 2026, citing below-peer EPS growth due to asset sensitivity and higher expense growth. Evercore ISI maintained Outperform with $340 price target on Apr 17 2026. Consensus as of May 5 2026: 33 analysts — 14 Buy, 12 Hold, 0 Sell; avg price target $339.46-$346.59, median $345, range $257.89-$420. Distribution: 19% Strong Buy, 44% Buy, 38% Hold, 0% Sell. (Sources: Benzinga, stockanalysis.com, public.com)

web_context.competitor_activity: Goldman Sachs posted record Q1 2026 equities trading revenue, putting pressure on JPM's investment banking division. Wells Fargo is aggressively expanding after regulators loosened its asset cap, increasing competition in consumer lending and credit cards. Bank of America is deepening cross-sell between consumer and wealth management. JPM's market cap has risen ~$200B since early 2025 and is approaching $1T, but its ~$10B incremental spend on AI, branches, and credit cards is drawing analyst scrutiny for operating leverage risk. (Source: CNBC, American Banker, Yahoo Finance)
web_context.earnings_info: Next earnings: July 14 2026 before market open (Q2 2026). Analyst EPS consensus estimate: $5.39. Q1 2026 actual EPS was $5.94, beating the $5.45 estimate. Q2 results will be a key read on tariff and geopolitical impact on net interest income and credit quality. (Sources: MarketBeat, Nasdaq, Investing.com)
